data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): The suite MUST cover all THREE marker states (the contract defines sweep|db|inconclusive plus absent), not only sweep-match. Assert the Migration-Class Pair Emission section specifies: (1) migration-class==sweep -> emit automated-sweep + manual-verification pair; (2) migration-class==inconclusive -> do NOT emit the sweep pair AND surface a decomposition_notes entry that detection was unavailable (inconclusive is first-class, never silently dropped); (3) marker absent/unparseable -> inert no-op (no pair), preserving backward compatibility. Each branch names its action distinctly. Verify: grep -qi 'inconclusive' tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh && grep -qi 'inconclusive' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
